title: Cool Breeze Citrus Lift

diffuser.notes: Add to diffuser with water; run for 30–60 minutes in a well-ventilated room.

spray_optional.note: Shake well before each use; mist lightly in air or on linens.

why_it_works: Lemon and peppermint create a bright, cooling aroma that feels refreshing in late summer heat, while eucalyptus adds a clean, airy note to clear the senses.
safety: Avoid eyes/mucosa; keep from children & pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under care.
